decision: Dung mot component dung chung ForeignText o packages/ui thay vi viet tay <span lang="en"> tai cho goi nhu 5 cho hien co
impact: Doi lai them mot vat vao packages/ui va mot lop nhap moi. Loai phuong an viet tay vi no DA troi o 3 cho (MetaLine, DetailSheetProse, timeline-entry) — day la so da xay ra, khong phai lo xa; va docs/design.md bat UI dung chung song o /packages/ui

decision: Chuyen luon 5 cho viet tay hien co sang ForeignText, khong chi 4 cho moi tren tam ho so
impact: Doi lai diff cham 5 file NGOAI pham vi tam ho so da chot. Nhan downside nay co y: cau 'component dung chung la con duong duy nhat' chi do duoc khi no dung, va mot component phu 4/9 cho khong chan duoc lan troi ke tiep — ma chan troi chinh la ly do da chon co che nay. Viec chuyen la co hoc, khong doi DOM sinh ra. Nguoi duyet thay dong nay tren the Cong 1 va cat duoc

decision: KHONG khai lang=en cho o nguoi nhap duoc (contact.title) va danh tu rieng (ten cong ty, dia danh), du chung cung la gia tri tu co so du lieu hien tren trang lang=vi
impact: Doi lai pham vi hep hon cach doc rong nhat cua AC-7 vong truoc. Ly do khong phai tiet kiem cong: khai cung lang=en len o nguoi go duoc la khai SAI — 'Giam doc kinh doanh' se bi doc bang bo phat am tieng Anh, dung cai loi dang va chi nguoc chieu. WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.2 goi ten dung hai ca nay trong ban ngoai le: proper names va words of indeterminate language. AC-5 la chieu do chong khai thua cho chinh quyet dinh nay

decision: bo design-pass — vong nay khong doi mot pixel nao, ForeignText sinh dung cay DOM ma 5 cho viet tay dang sinh
impact: Gate 1 duyet UI bang chu — mat khoanh khac visual truoc duyet. Nhan doi lai: mot phien tham my tren ban bam duoc se khong co gi de nhin, vi thay doi nay chi trinh doc man hinh nghe thay. Dac ta UX trong design-doc khai ro o muc 4: khong co thay doi thi giac nao

decision: Canh hoi quy nam cho cu bang cach CHAY LAI nguyen trang chan do cua ho so nhan-ung-dung-noi-tieng-viet, thay vi viet mot chan do man danh sach moi hoac mo lai ho so cu
impact: Loai hai duong: (a) mo lai ho so cu — chu kho da cam, va no khong can thiet vi chay lai mot cai THUOC khong phai mo lai mot LOI HUA; (b) viet chan do moi cho man danh sach — ton cong va te hon, vi thuoc moi khong chung minh duoc rang thuoc CU van xanh, ma dung cai thuoc cu moi la thu vong truoc da ky ten len. Doi lai: vong nay phu thuoc vao mot tep song trong cay ho so cua vong khac, va neu ai do xoa tep do thi E12 gay
